title: Devices
subtitle: Every device paired to the mother. A command reaches the device in about 10 seconds.
unreachable: Can't reach the mother: the device list isn't available right now.
tickOne: Tick at least one online device
selfNotSelectable: Use the row buttons for this device
lockTitle: Lock this device (its PIN is required to unlock it)
lockSelectedTitle: Lock the selected devices (their PIN is required to unlock them)
logoTitle: Show the logo screen on this device
logoSelectedTitle: Show the logo screen on the selected devices
rejoinTitle: Bring this device back to the game page of "{{name}}"
offlineActionTitle: Device not connected to the mother
statusOffPageTitle: Registered in a game but not showing its game page
syncAllTitle: Sync the content of every device that needs it
updateAllTitle: Update the app on every device that needs it
syncTitle: Sync this device's content now (studio, or the mother without internet)
updateTitle: Download and install version {{version}} on this device
updateRetryTitle: Retry the update on this device
updateForceTitle: A game is running on this device: the update is ready and waits for the game to end
updateConfirmSelf: This device will download the new version, then restart. If a game is running here, it will wait for the game to end.
updateConfirmSelfForce: A game is running on this device. Restart now to install the update?
updateConfirmForce: A game is running on "{{name}}". Restart it now to install the update?
updateConfirmBulk_one: {{count}} device will download the new version, then restart. If it has a game running, it will wait for the game to end.
updateConfirmBulk_other: {{count}} devices will download the new version, then restart. Those with a game running will wait for the game to end.
oldBuildTitle: This version can't be updated remotely: update it on the device
updReadyGameRunning: ready, waiting for the game to end
syncNoSource: Neither internet nor a mother to sync with
homeTitle: Close everything on this device (ranking, video, game page) and show the logo screen. It stays registered in its game: "Back to the game" returns it there.
homeSelectedTitle: Close everything on the selected devices and show their logo screen (they stay registered in their game)
muteTitle: Mute every sound on this device (like Ctrl+M). Sound comes back when the app restarts.
unmuteTitle: Turn the sound back on on this device
unmuteSelectedTitle: Turn the sound back on on the selected devices
readerRefreshTitle: Look for this device's SportIdent reader and reconnect it
readerBeepTitle: Make this device's SportIdent reader beep twice
restartTitle: Restart the app on this device (refused while a game runs there)
restartConfirm: Restart the app on "{{name}}"? It comes back by itself within a few seconds.
restartConfirmForce: A game may be running on "{{name}}". Restart it anyway? The game screen will be interrupted for a few seconds.
restartConfirmMother: "{{name}}" is the mother: while it restarts, every device loses the game for a few seconds. Restart it anyway?
needsUpdate: Update the app on this device for this action
startGameTitle: Start the game on this device's registration screen
resetDisplayTitle: Clear the result shown on this device for the next team
statusResultsTitle: A result is waiting to be cleared (button, Enter or "Reset")

cmdError.target_outdated: Version too old for this action: update the device
cmdError.target_not_in_game: The device is no longer in this game
cmdError.target_operator_only: Operator-only device: it does not play
cmdError.already_in_game: The device is already in this game
cmdError.game_running: A game is running on this device: use "Restart even during a game"
cmdError.not_registering: The device is not showing the registration screen
cmdError.nothing_to_reset: No result to clear on this device
cmdError.operator_only: Operator-only device: it does not play
cmdError.just_started: The app just started: try again in a minute
cmdError.stale: Command too old, ignored: try again
cmdError.timeout: The device did not finish in time
cmdError.no_handler: This device's version cannot do this action
cmdError.no_videos: No video available on this device
cmdError.game_unreachable: The device cannot reach the game

unlockTitle: Locked - click to unlock it (without its PIN)
hideLogoTitle: On the logo screen - click to go back to what it was showing
readerOnTitle: SportIdent reader plugged in - click to reconnect it
readerOffTitle: No SportIdent reader detected - click to look for it
